purpose: Replay persisted world paint delta records onto scene maps for save/load reconstruction, editor preview, migration, and host/client synchronization dry runs.
rules: Replay never treats raw visual overlays as authoritative state.
Unknown scenes, families, or subcell modes are skipped and reported instead of panicking.
Replay uses the same deterministic brush backend as live painting.
Scene-filtered replay can rebuild only the active scene for fast dev overlay workflows.
All-scene replay is intended for save/load, migration, and host/client synchronization testing.
